title: Food Safety Tracking Log
subtitle: Food Safety Control: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Food Safety Tracking Log covers food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action. The food-safety record owner records Food Safety Control events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Food Safety Tracking Log keeps Food Safety Control exceptions visible until the food-safety record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Food Safety Tracking Log at receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area. Document food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action identity before Food Safety Control begins. Compare food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action findings with stated Food Safety Control criteria; route unresolved Food Safety Control issues to qualified food-safety reviewer. For Food Safety Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Food Safety Control. Ask qualified food-safety reviewer to review Food Safety Control conditions beyond the food-safety record owner's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Food Safety Control, identify responsible parties, receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area, and the linked food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action source.

fields.label: Control point, limit, method, and monitoring device

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Food Safety Control facts for food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Food Safety Control tracked controls
items: Pest, waste, water, and facility condition

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Food Safety Control event before closeout. Food-Safety Record Owner identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Hold, correction, verification, and release decision
blocks.guidance: Pause Food Safety Control when product control, traceability, contamination, corrective action, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Food Safety Control proof and route unresolved food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action scope to food-safety record owner.
